==About me==

''I'm an avid reader of the ''Wheel of Time'' series, and currently getting my teeth into ''Towers of Midnight''.  I am a writer myself, and have my own wikia project - to create one for my books.  Unfortunately, I have no idea where to begin with coding, and while I would love my wiki to look as brilliant as this one, that will most likely never happen.''

I have an obsession with organising things, and find editting pages rather fun, so no doubt I shall be scouring over many pages on here in the future!
